title: security-eng-sync-notes-2026-03-08
content:
Security Engineering Sync — Notes and Action Items
Date: 2026-03-08
Attendees: Riley Chen (owner), Aditi Patel, Marco Ruiz, Leah Thompson, Omar Haddad, guest: Priya Nair (infra)

1) Quick status updates
- Vulnerability triage backlog: ~18 open tickets (down from 24 last week). Focused on high/critical libs and infra exposures.
- Secrets scan: periodic run completed 2026-03-07; 6 new findings flagged (4 false positives, 2 confirmed).
- Threat modeling: kickoff for Billing API v2 scheduled; design doc ready for review.

2) Vulnerability triage (details)
- JIRA-SEC-2145: openssl 1.1.1 -> 1.1.1s (moderate/urgent due to internal usage in build runner). Assessment: library is used in legacy build-runner containers. Action: create mitigations to rotate build runner pool off legacy image and schedule upgrade next maintenance window. Owner: Marco. ETA: 2026-03-18.
- JIRA-SEC-2158: dependency-high: graphql-parser remote DoS reported upstream (low exploitability in our usage). Assessment: public-facing endpoints use rate limiting; signature: medium. Action: add additional rate limit rule on /api/graphql and add a regression test. Owner: Aditi. ETA: 2026-03-12.
- New: container runtime CVE candidate reported by SRE. Marked as P2 until we confirm kernel config. Action: SRE to provide repro, security to validate. Owner: Leah. ETA: 2026-03-11.

3) Secrets scanning and remediation
- Findings summary: 6 findings from the weekly scan on 2026-03-07. Two confirmed secrets: a rotated service token in a dev repo and an old AWS key in a backup folder. Both have low blast radius (dev namespace, no prod access).
- Remediations completed: rotated the dev service token (PR #412 on infra-config), removed backup key, and triggered investigators to audit access logs.
- Follow-up: implement pre-commit hook repo-wide to block commits with high-entropy strings matching credentials pattern. Owner: Omar. ETA: 2026-03-22.
- Policy note: re-evaluate current false-positive rules for base64/PEM detection; Leah to consolidate examples and propose rule updates. ETA: 2026-03-15.

4) Threat modeling session notes (Billing API v2)
- Scope: billing-api-v2 will introduce an async webhook consumer and a new internal scheduled job for reconciliation.
- Primary assets: payment instrument blob, invoice records, reconciliation materialized views.
- Trust boundaries discussed: public webhook -> webhook consumer (zone: public edge) -> internal queue -> reconciliation job (zone: internal).
- Threats identified: replay attacks on webhook, queue poisoning, excessive data exposure in reconciliation debug logs.
- Mitigations agreed: implement HMAC verification for webhooks, add monotonic sequence/replay window, ensure queue messages are signed and verify consumer signature, redact PII in reconciliation logs and enforce 30-day retention.
- Action items: Priya to add HMAC header spec to openapi and forward to SDK team. Aditi to produce a minimal threat-model diagram and upload to Confluence. Owner/ETA: Priya/2026-03-10; Aditi/2026-03-12.

5) Incident posture and tabletop follow-up
- Tabletop run (2026-03-05) produced two gaps: incomplete runbook for partial compromise of CI runner and missing cross-team paging for infra on weekends.
- Actions: create CI-runner compromise runbook draft (Riley). Define weekend on-call rotation for infra paging and confirm with SRE. Owner: Riley & Leah. ETA: 2026-03-16.

6) Operational tooling and telemetry
- Observability: add tokenized metric for secrets-scan false positive rate to track improvements. Omar to add Grafana panel and alert. ETA: 2026-03-20.
- Canary rollout guard: console needs a safety toggle to disable canary traffic for a given model endpoint if a sev3 bug is detected; product requested a short spec. Marco to draft spec and sync with product. ETA: 2026-03-14.

7) PRs, docs, and reviews
- PR #412 (infra-config): rotated dev service token — merged.
- PR #418 (rate-limit): rate-limit change for /api/graphql — awaiting security review (Aditi assigned).
- Threat model doc: new Confluence page created (CONFLUENCE-SEC/infra-threat-model-2026) — reviewers: security + infra.

8) Decisions and escalations
- Decision: prioritize HMAC verification for webhooks before beta release. Rationale: low implementation cost, high reduction in replay risk.
- Escalation: request for emergency quota on dedicated pool to run dependency upgrades; finance needs justification. Marco to prepare cost delta and risk note. ETA: 2026-03-13.

9) Action item recap (owner / ETA)
- Marco: upgrade build-runner image and provide cost justification for dedicated pool (2026-03-18 / 2026-03-13).
- Aditi: add rate-limit regression test, produce threat-model diagram (2026-03-12).
- Leah: validate container runtime CVE repro and consolidate secrets scan false-positive examples (2026-03-11 / 2026-03-15).
- Omar: pre-commit hook rollout, add Grafana panel (2026-03-22 / 2026-03-20).
- Priya: add HMAC header spec to OpenAPI and notify SDK (2026-03-10).
- Riley: draft CI-runner compromise runbook and confirm weekend paging (2026-03-16).

Notes: please update Jira tickets when work starts and link PRs to the ticket. Next sync: 2026-03-15 (weekly cadence).

End of notes.
